facts: Adults should get at least 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity per week, or 75–150 minutes of vigorous-intensity activity, or an equivalent combination.
Adults should do muscle-strengthening activities involving all major muscle groups on 2 or more days per week.
Inactive people should start with smaller amounts and gradually increase duration, frequency and intensity.
Some physical activity is better than none.
Adults 65+ have the same general aerobic and strengthening targets, with added emphasis on functional balance and strength for people with poor mobility.
